n: REV Robotics Intro to Robotics V2
t: A semester-long high school robotics course written for REV hardware.
steps: Find the Intro to Robotics V2 page on the REV Robotics site.
Fill out the Curriculum Response Form to get a coupon code.
Add the course to the cart and apply the code.
Choose the Google, Microsoft, or SCORM version.
Buy the REV EDU Kit V2 or a DUO kit for the builds.
Ask IT to check the programming software on student computers.
